svg.title: Figure 12.1 · Causal, offset and windowed masks
svg.desc: Four 0/1 grids. Causal: lower triangle of a 6 by 6 grid. Offset: three new queries at positions 3 to 5 against six keys see keys up to their own position. The same call with is_causal sees a top-left triangle instead, nine cells wrong. Window of 3: a band of width three along the diagonal.
svg.text: Which keys each query may see
rows: queries · columns: keys, positions 0–5 · gold = may attend · hatched = masked
each query loses its own key
_attn_mask returns None for the causal case, so SDPA builds that mask itself; the other three are built explicitly.
